text: Dear Editor, as a senior at this university, I am writing to offer constructive suggestions on campus facilities.
Thank you for your previous email asking about our upcoming campus cultural event.
Notice: To enrich campus life, the Student Union is scheduled to host a singing contest in the hall next Friday.
It would be deeply appreciated if the library could extend its opening hours, which would greatly facilitate daily study.
Equally important is that each team is expected to consist of three to five students.
I deem it imperative that prompt measures be taken to rectify this substandard service.
Much to my regret, my tight exam schedule prevented me from attending the lecture on time.
Not only can this exchange broaden our horizons, but it also strengthens mutual trust. Yours sincerely, Li Ming.
